qk.qm_key_off: Answer notes are off; turn them on in Boxes.
qk.qm_key_all: It goes on every paper in a gold note.
qk.qm_key_miss: It goes in a gold note on papers that lost points here.
qk.qm_ans_tip: Goes on their paper in gold. Change where answers go in Boxes.
qk.qm_pin_tip: Where the mark goes on this paper. Drag to move it on this paper only.
qk.qm_mk_tip: Drag to move this mark on this paper only
qk.qm_img_tip: Click: wrong / right. Drag: line this paper up
qk.qm_no_page: This page isn’t in their scan.
qk.qm_half_tip: Add or take off half a point (H)
qk.qm_cm_tip: Write a comment or text on this paper (C)
qk.qm_reset_tip: Put this mark back where the question’s mark goes
qk.qm_copy_tip: Copy this answer as a picture, to paste into your assistant or anywhere else. No name, score or mark on it (P)
qk.qm_note_ph: Type what to write on their paper…
qk.qm_note_keys: Enter to save, Esc to cancel
qk.qm_ink_credit_tip: Full points in the ✓ color, part in amber, none in the ✗ color
qk.qm_ink_credit_say: Full: 2/2 · part: 1/2 · none: 0/2. Totals and score stamps stay in the ✗ color.
qk.qm_copied: Picture of {q} copied. Paste it into {ai} to ask about it.
qk.qm_saved_pic: This browser can’t copy pictures, so {q} was saved as a picture file.
qk.qm_cn_1: Only this answer, with the question and your answer key on top. The student’s name, their score, your mark and the file name are left off, and any name covers are painted in. It still shows the student’s own handwriting and words.
qk.qm_cn_2: Nothing is sent anywhere. The picture stays on this computer until you paste it somewhere yourself.
qk.qm_all_done: Everything here is marked. Pick All to see the marked ones.
qk.qm_hint_pts: Keys: a number for its points, H adds ½,
qk.qm_hint_rw: Click an answer to put an ✗ on it, click again to take it off. Keys: 1 right, 0 or X wrong,
qk.qm_hint_q: C comment, P copy a picture, arrows to move, Space whole page, Ctrl Z undo, [ and ] for the question. Drag a mark to move it on that paper.
qk.qm_hint_s: Click an answer to put an ✗ on it, click again to take it off. Keys: ↑ ↓ to move, a number for its points, C comment, P copy a picture, Space whole page, Ctrl Z undo, [ and ] for the student.
qk.qb_about: Drag a box around each question, in order. Boxes can overlap. Drag a box’s number to move it. Click a box to resize it from a corner or set where its mark goes. Then give each one its points, how it’s scored (right or wrong, or a scale like 0 to 2 for a short answer) and the right answer if it has one. The answer can go on the returned papers in a gold note.
qk.qb_lv_sub: the lowest points that earn each level
qk.qb_lv_cell: Lowest points for level {n} of criterion {k}
qk.qb_lv_none: No levels yet: this criterion shows its points only.
qk.qb_lv_fill: Fill in all {n}, each at least as many points as the one before.
qk.qb_lv_over: Level {n} needs {p} points and these questions add up to {max}.
qk.qb_lv_bad: Finish the levels for criterion {list}, or clear them
qk.qb_words_sub: shown on the buttons while you mark
qk.qb_spot_page: Pick a spot on page {n}, where question {q} is
qk.qb_line_pin: starts at the gold pin you dragged
qk.qb_line_at: starts {at}. Drag the gold pin to change it.
qk.qb_pin_tip: Where the mark goes. Drag to move it.
qk.qb_apin_tip: Where the line to question {q}’s answer note starts. Drag to move it.
qk.qb_ans_say_off: The answers you type stay with you while you mark.
qk.qb_ans_say_all: A gold note with the answer goes by every question that has one, on every paper.
qk.qb_ans_say_miss: A gold note with the answer goes by each question a student lost points on.
qk.qb_at_sub: unless you drag a gold pin.
qk.qb_put_back: Put back answer notes moved on single papers ({n})
qk.qb_back_say: Answer notes moved on single papers go back when you save.
qk.qb_total_at: The score goes on page {n} once every question is marked.
qk.qb_total_lv_at: The levels go on page {n} once every question is marked.
qk.qb_total_opt: Optional: a spot on the paper for the score, like 18/20 = 90%.
qk.qb_total_lv_opt: Optional: a spot on the paper for the levels, like A 6.
qk.qb_keys: Keys for the picked box: arrows move it, Shift + arrows resize it, Ctrl D copies it just below, Delete takes it out.
qk.qb_saved_points: Boxes saved. The score is out of {n} points now.
qk.qb_saved_rubric: Boxes saved. Quick mark scores this assignment out of {n} points now; the rubric scores stay saved but stop counting.
qk.qf_text_ph_sheet: Type the question (optional on an answer sheet)
qk.qf_sa_say: Students write on the lines. You mark it by filling a score bubble, 0 to {n}, in the Teacher box, and the scan reads your score too. Or leave it blank and mark it in Quick mark.
qk.qf_keys: Right answers: {list}. All of them, and no others, for the points.
qk.qf_no_key: Click a letter to set the right answer.
qk.qf_sum: {n} questions, {pts} points · {pages} pages each · {auto} scored by the scan, {sa} marked by you
qk.qf_saved_moved: Quiz saved. This change moves bubbles, so print it again: copies printed before can’t be read by the scan.
qk.qf_blocked: Your browser blocked the print window
qk.qr_none: No pages of this quiz were found in the papers
qk.qr_t_seen: students found by the code on their pages
qk.qr_old1: 1 page was printed before the quiz was last changed, so it wasn’t read. Mark it in Quick mark.
qk.qr_old: {n} pages were printed before the quiz was last changed, so they weren’t read. Mark them in Quick mark.
qk.qr_pick: These weren’t clear enough to score on their own. Pick what each student meant. A highlighted button is the scan’s best guess.
qk.qr_foot: Every score can be changed in Quick mark. Ctrl Z takes the scan’s scores back.
qk.qr_again_tip: Read every page again. Answers you already have stay as they are.
qk.qm_ex_tip: Keep this answer as a strong example, with the name covered (E)
qk.qm_ex_on: Kept as a strong example. Click to take it off (E)
